description: One tempo for DJing: allin1's beat-derived BPM when both trackers agree; on a half/double disagreement, whichever lies in 100-140 BPM
key on the Camelot wheel (8A = A minor); neighbours (+-1, same number A/B) mix harmonically
Bars before the bass stem first plays (mix-in runway without two basslines)
Bars in the closing outro section
Sections with start-end times (s), repeats merged; allin1 uses pop-style labels
Bass stem (Demucs via allin1): one digit per bar, 1 = playing
Vocals stem (Demucs via allin1): one digit per bar, 1 = playing
Spectral centroid, brightness (Hz), mean over frames
Vocals stem (Demucs via allin1): share of bars where it plays
Drums stem (Demucs via allin1): share of total stem energy
